candidates.requirement: Enable built in PRIORITY_UPDATE reception and submit local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so the server receiver processes a valid PRIORITY_UPDATE frame.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a server session, submits SETTINGS, calls nghttp2_session_mem_recv on the supplied bytes, then sends pending frames and deletes the session.
candidates.failure_condition: The constructor receives a null option, leaving builtin_recv_ext_types zero, so every PRIORITY_UPDATE frame enters IGN_PAYLOAD before unpacking or priority handling. The sole submitted setting also makes pending_no_rfc7540_priorities zero.
candidates.alternative_paths: A peer SETTINGS value changes remote settings, not the required local pending setting. The user extension route is disabled by the null option and lacks an unpack callback. Additional input bytes cannot change either target controlled prerequisite.

candidates.requirement: Submit local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so received request Priority fields exercise the new valid and bad priority state handling.
candidates.target_route: The entry's server session receives a valid request HEADERS block through nghttp2_session_mem_recv; header inflation calls HTTP request header handling, followed by end of header block priority application.
candidates.failure_condition: The target submits only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS. nghttp2_session_add_settings sets pending_no_rfc7540_priorities to zero, so newly opened streams lack NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES and the changed Priority field handling cannot execute.
candidates.alternative_paths: Peer SETTINGS updates remote_settings, while the request header guard requires a stream flag derived from local pending_no_rfc7540_priorities. More request bytes or repeated Priority fields cannot set that flag.
